newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly unchanged in slow talk.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly unchanged in slow talk.

text.p: NWE oil products were notionally unchanged on Monday in a quiet market slowed by a holiday in much of Europe, traders said.
Gas oil was $2.75 a tonne firmer on the screen but barge premiums were steady at around $2.50/$3.50 for heating oil and $9.50/$10.50 for low sulphur diesel.

Prompt fuel oil was unchanged at around $83/$85 a tonne, with first half June at $85/$86. Prompt premium unleaded gasoline was offered a touch higher and valued at $206 a tonne, but no bids were heard. June paper was around $208.50.
